name: backend-conventions
description: Sentry backend conventions for logging, tracing/spans, span/tag attribute naming, metrics tags, and the options system. Use when adding or editing Python in src/ that logs (logger.info/exception), records metrics (metrics.incr/timing with tags), instruments spans/transactions, calls sentry_sdk.set_tag/set_attribute or set_span_tag/set_span_data, or reads registered options with options.get(). author: getsentry
